coverage.text_review: Exhaustive across lesson and step text, prose, nested visual text, code walkthroughs and annotations, media summaries and bridges, recaps, up-next text, and remediation blocks.
coverage.sampling_method: Choice interactions whose step number is divisible by three, plus the first code exercise in each tile. The sample was expanded beyond one third to include hands-on learner code and prompts in every tile. Reviewed public prompts/options, feedback/hints, and learner regions of sampled workspaces; host fixture implementation was not treated as required learner knowledge.

assessment: No reviewed text or sampled interaction requires understanding a blocked future concept. Within multi-concept tiles, examples follow the local concept teaching order. References to future topics in up-next blocks are passing mentions only.
boundary_notes: FileExistsError in the file-modes tile is explicitly part of that concept's required fact f5, not a dependency on the later file-and-format-errors concept.

Initializer syntax and self attribute assignments in the initialization section are explicitly taught by its current facts f1-f3; ordinary instance-method binding is introduced in the subsequent section.
Printed object representations in the initial classes media summary illustrate distinct objects without requiring the learner to understand or implement special methods.

The encoding section teaches UnicodeDecodeError as its own fact f3 and uses explicit close calls; it does not require the later resource-management concept. The file-and-format-errors section likewise uses explicit finally cleanup before with is taught.
Pathlib traversal uses an ordinary for loop, an explicit prerequisite; understanding the later iterator protocol is unnecessary.
Host-side fixtures and representation fallback demonstrations are identified as supplied infrastructure rather than code the learner must understand or implement.
